task.description:
Validate src/design/iss0627-lint-handoffs-acknowledgment.md before BACKEND-DEV implements it. This design covers a permanent-acknowledgment baseline mechanism for tools/lint_handoffs.py's H003/H004/H005/H009 categories (225 findings) -- these are unrecoverable historical audit-trail gaps (inverted/missing timestamps, orphaned pipeline steps) that must stay permanently visible while no longer gating exit code.

ORCH already independently verified the design's most safety-critical claim: read tools/lint_handoffs.py's actual lint_orphans function directly and confirmed H009's message genuinely only embeds len(later_completed) (a count) and run_id -- NEVER the identity of which steps completed later. This means two DIFFERENT orphan situations on the same file (same count, different actual bypassing steps) could produce a byte-identical message under naive severity|code|path|message key matching -- a genuine safety gap CODE-DESIGNER found, evidenced via git log --diff-filter=D showing handoff step files have in fact been added/removed within run directories historically, and fixed by adding an H009-only key component: a stable sorted fingerprint of later_completed's actual file paths. ORCH confirmed this fix is present in the design (search 'H009-only' and section 0.2's worked example) and that python tools/lint_design_artefact.py exits 0.

YOUR JOB: run your own full independent validation -- do not just trust ORCH's spot-check of the H009 fix was sufficient or that it's the only issue worth finding. In particular:
1. Read the ENTIRE 935-line design fresh.
2. Independently verify H003/H004/H005's messages genuinely DO embed differing values that make plain message-text matching safe for them (read the actual H003/H004/H005 detection code in lint_handoffs.py yourself, don't just trust the design's claim).
3. Verify the H009 fingerprint fix is actually well-specified enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement unambiguously -- is 'stable sorted fingerprint of later_completed's file paths' precise (e.g. exact serialization format, hash vs. raw sorted list) or does it leave a gap an implementation could get wrong?
4. Verify the design's claim that the one-time generation script reuses (imports, calls) lint_handoffs.py's EXISTING _lint_parsed_handoff/lint_orphans functions rather than reimplementing the H003/H004/H005/H009 predicates a second time -- reimplementation would risk the two copies silently drifting apart over time.
5. Verify the ACKNOWLEDGED bucket's exit-code interaction is precisely specified (excluded from BLOCKER/MAJOR count, but still individually printed) and that --no-baseline's audit behavior is unambiguous.
6. Verify the design explicitly and correctly distinguishes this mechanism from --changed mode's GH-594 preexisting_file_finding_codes/preexisting_run_finding_codes logic -- these must compose as two independent gates, not be accidentally merged into one, since they answer different questions (permanent acceptance vs. did-this-branch-introduce-it).
7. Verify record-location choice (tools/lint_handoffs.baseline.json) is adequately justified against the docs/issues/ alternative.
8. Confirm the shared-reasons-map decision (one reason per category, not 225 individual reasons) is explicitly justified, not silently assumed.
9. Confirm all mutation-checkable test specs actually prove: a baseline-matched finding is excluded from gating but still printed; a genuinely NEW finding (including a new H009 with a different later_completed set on an already-baselined file) is NOT excluded; --no-baseline restores full gating.
10. Confirm scope discipline: does not touch tools/repair_handoff_bookkeeping.py's GH-594 scope, explicitly excludes H013/H001-structural/H006-CONDITIONAL/H007.
acceptance_criteria: H003/H004/H005 message-uniqueness claims independently verified against real source
H009 fingerprint fix precisely specified, unambiguous for implementation
Generation script reuse (not reimplementation) of existing predicates confirmed
ACKNOWLEDGED bucket exit-code/print semantics precisely specified
Composition with --changed mode confirmed as two independent gates
Record location and shared-reasons-map decisions explicitly justified
Test specs cover new-finding-not-suppressed case including H009 fingerprint variation
